title: What a well-planned migration can improve
intro: The benefits depend on your starting environment and the decisions made during the move. We review these areas against your requirements with your team.
descriptions: Connect resource choices and usage to operating costs, including the cost of maintaining the new environment.
Choose capacity and scaling options that can respond to demand without relying only on hardware purchases.
Make access, network boundaries, patching responsibilities, and recovery procedures explicit and reviewable.
Use repeatable environment setup and clearer operating documentation to make infrastructure changes easier to manage.
alt: Three colleagues collaborating around a laptop, with one holding a tablet
